claim.text: Excel WEEKDAY accepts return_type values 1, 2, 3, and 11 through 17 with their documented weekday numbering, and returns #NUM! for selectors outside that set.
claim.subject_definition: The WEEKDAY function in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop

source.excerpt: Microsoft’s WEEKDAY page lists the numbering for 1 or omitted, 2, 3, and 11 through 17. It says an out-of-range return_type produces #NUM!.
source.subject_definition: The WEEKDAY function in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop
source.scope: Official Microsoft Support function page, retrieved 2026-09-24
